title: Error Handling
description: Handle errors gracefully without obscuring business logic.

data.text: **Clean error handling** keeps your code readable while properly managing exceptions. Use exceptions rather than return codes, and keep business logic separate from error handling.

data.title: Clean Error Handling
Key Takeaways
points: Use exceptions instead of error codes
Don't return null – use Option pattern or empty collections
data.takeaway: Handle errors at the appropriate level and keep business logic clean.
